fileSnippets.content: export function countReady(rows) { return rows.filter(r => r.status === 'DONE' && r.rounds > 2 && r.checks >= 4 && r.reviewed === true).length; }
计数规则：status为DONE、rounds至少2、checks至少4、reviewed为true必须同时满足；archived不影响是否计入。返回人数，空数组返回0。
